selection.stop: no extra candidates or seeds; report residual failures
selection.robustness_requirement: zero collapses, zero execution failures, all primary engineering gates pass, all control expectations met; descriptive only

grid.encoder_quantiles: inclusive uniform grid over each candidates init interval
grid.interpretation: fraction of finite equally weighted grid points only; not continuous init probability; consumer slice differs from seeded initialization

reward_engineering.scope: erasure only; additional diagnostics, unchanged protocol gates

budget_matching: R2 slows both consumer and comparator; fixed 400 iterations for all arms
fresh_seed_chronology: 100–104 allocated before candidate execution; previously used 0–4 restricted to historical reconstruction
